# JurrSelf

> JurrSelf is a guided experience in Javea (Spain) where the body is the way in: breathwork, ice bath and physical training, guided by Jurriaan. No gym, no wellness concept, no traditional coaching.

## Pages
- [Home](https://jurrself.com/): what JurrSelf is and who it is for.
- [Offer](https://jurrself.com/offer): the JurrSelf Experience (breathwork and ice bath) and the Programme (functional 1-on-1 physical training).
- [About](https://jurrself.com/about): Jurriaan and how he guides.
- [Contact](https://jurrself.com/contact): book a session or get to know each other first, via the form, WhatsApp or email.

## Facts
- Location: Javea, Spain.
- Site languages: English (default, at /), Dutch (/nl/) and Spanish (/es/).
